complaint.symptom: Player takes a long time to appear on first and subsequent selections.

runtime_measurement.scope: HTTPS reads from runtime host; excludes user device network, browser decode and native player retirement.
runtime_measurement.provenance: User supplied aggregate output from compiled diagnose_voice_loading.pyc; no private audio or credential exported.

findings: The server responded quickly for these eight samples. This does not time the user PC connection.
The original review card followed profiles and the entire recordings table, with no scroll or selected-button loading feedback.
Local Chromium prepared the original selected Blob quickly even with preload=none; preload is not established as the cause.
changes: Place the review card before the list and scroll it into view when a recording is selected.
Show an immediate empty native player with Cargando audio… while the authenticated sample is prepared; disable listen buttons during the admitted request.
Explicitly preload only the selected authorized Blob; keep the same live player on reselection.
Preserve body release, native emptied acknowledgement and expiry/session retirement contracts.
limits: Actual Chrome on Windows and the user LAN have not been timed or reproduced.
A delayed HTTP response was injected to verify immediate loading feedback, not to simulate every source of the reported delay.
This is not an audio quality change or a general service health acceptance.
